trap: Rare-word substitution creates high block entropy without elaboration depth
anchor: The design is elegant. It works effectively.
less_creative: The design is perspicacious. It functions efficaciously.
more_creative: The design balances simplicity with robust functionality. It works through thoughtful structural choices.
design_note: Substitution at key tokens (perspicacious, efficacious) creates multiple size-1 blocks. Changed tokens all rare (surprisal >18) → high gate. Block entropy high from uniform small blocks. True elaboration uses common words (balances, through, thoughtful) diluting mean surprisal despite more structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: Less creative: ~2 replacements (perspicacious, efficacious) form size-1 blocks; entropy ~log2(4)≈2.0, gate ~0.88. Score ~0.78. More creative: Added tokens (balances, through, thoughtful) are common; block mix is varied but mean surprisal diluted to ~8 bits; gate ~0.64, signal ~0.82, score ~0.52. Champion misses that jargon swap masks zero elaboration.

trap: Morphological sophistication without semantic depth exploits token-level rarity
anchor: The team worked hard and achieved measurable results. Their effort was genuine.
less_creative: The assemblage labored assiduously and attained quantifiable outcomes. Their exertion was authentic.
more_creative: The team worked hard, collaborating across departments and refining approaches iteratively. They achieved results through sustained focus.
design_note: Jargon substitutions (assemblage→team generalized, labored, assiduously, attained, outcomes, exertion) are systematic and rare. Block entropy from multiple small replace blocks. Changed words all sophisticated → high gate. True elaboration adds explanatory detail (collaborating, iteratively, sustained) with common words → lower gate despite better structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: Less creative: ~4-5 replacements, most size-1; entropy ~1.8-2.0; changed words all rare (assemblag|e, assiduously, quantifiable); gate ~0.85; signal ~0.8; score ~0.68. More creative: longer blocks from additions; gate ~0.60 (common expanding words); signal ~0.80; score ~0.48. Scorer rewards vocabulary density over elaboration depth.

trap: Rare words concentrated in minimal edits mask lack of semantic novelty
anchor: Learning is valuable. It helps people succeed.
less_creative: Pedagogy is felicitous. It facilitates human advancement.
more_creative: Learning opens possibilities, builds confidence, and equips people with unexpected capabilities to handle challenges.
design_note: Minimal substitution (Pedagogy, felicitous, facilitates, advancement) but each token ultra-rare. Few blocks but all changed tokens extreme surprisal → high gate despite low structural signal. True elaboration has much higher structure (added clauses, conjunctions) but common words (opens, builds, equips, unexpected) dilute mean surprisal.
predicted_champion_behavior: Less creative: 3-4 replacements, small blocks; entropy moderate ~1.5; mean surprisal ultra-high (~19); gate ~0.90; signal ~0.70; score ~0.63. More creative: 5+ blocks from elaboration; signal ~0.85; but gate ~0.55 (common words: opens, builds, equips); score ~0.47. Scorer penalizes common-word elaboration while rewarding rare-word density.

trap: Pseudo-paraphrasing with rare synonyms generates artificial structural entropy
anchor: The solution was simple and worked. It surprised everyone.
less_creative: The resolution was elementary and functioned. It astonished the assemblage.
more_creative: The solution's simplicity proved deceptive; it worked because it leveraged hidden principles, surprising even experienced observers.
design_note: Substitutions (resolution, elementary, functioned, astonished, assemblage) are systematic and rare. Each creates a block; high block count → high entropy. Mean surprisal of changed tokens very high. Genuine elaboration (deceptive, leveraged, hidden, principles, experienced) has fewer blocks and lower mean rarity due to common words (proved, because, even).
predicted_champion_behavior: Less creative: 4-5 replacements, avg size 1-1.5; entropy ~1.8; mean surprisal ~17.5; gate ~0.87; signal ~0.78; score ~0.68. More creative: 3 major blocks from elaboration structure; signal ~0.80; gate ~0.60 (common: proved, because, leveraged); score ~0.48. Champion rewards substitution-density over semantic complexity.

trap: Expanded elaboration with simple vocabulary scores lower despite superior creativity
anchor: The writer found a good idea.
more_creative: The writer found an idea that worked, one that opened new directions and revealed unexpected connections across the project.
less_creative: The scribe discovered a felicitous notion.
design_note: More creative has extensive elaboration (found, worked, opened, revealed, unexpected, connections) but vocabulary largely common (that, new, directions, across, project). Low mean surprisal → low gate. Fewer blocks despite more content. Less creative: minimal substitution (scribe, felicitous, notion) but all rare → high gate, medium signal. Champion inverts quality ranking.
predicted_champion_behavior: More creative: 6-7 content tokens added (worked, opened, revealed, connections, project, unexpected), mostly common-to-mid rarity; gate ~0.55; block structure moderate (3 blocks); signal ~0.75; score ~0.41. Less creative: 2-3 replacements, ultra-rare (scribe, felicitous, notion); gate ~0.88; signal ~0.65; score ~0.57. Champion rates pseudo-elaboration above genuine elaboration.

trap: Systematic lexical substitution mimics structural diversity through micro-edits

trap: Phrasal elaboration penalized for accessible vocabulary while pseudo-substitution rewarded

trap: Verb precision through deletion beats elaboration
anchor: She talked to her friends about the problem, and they discussed several possible solutions together.
more_creative: She voiced her problem clearly. They listened without interrupting, then offered fresh ideas of their own.
less_creative: She engaged in extended dialogue with her intimate cohort regarding the predicament, and they deliberated extensively, proposing alternative methodologies and divergent strategic approaches.
design_note: More creative uses simple verbs (voiced, listened, offered) with one precise choice (voiced implies clarity). Less creative inflates with rare words (cohort, predicament, deliberated, methodologies) and complex structure (alternative, divergent) but says nothing new. Champion will rate less_creative higher due to rare vocabulary (cohort, predicament, methodologies) and structural variation.
predicted_champion_behavior: Rare words (cohort, predicament, methodologies) and passive-like elaboration boost lexical_rarity gate; complex structure variations increase difflib block entropy; champion scores less_creative ~0.78, more_creative ~0.42.

anchor: The woman slowly climbed the stairs, holding the railing tightly because she was afraid of falling.
